messages:
meera: quick thread to dump results from the speculative sweep i ran this morning on q4-mini-7b (8-bit quant). tl;dr: we see a small but consistent QA/F1 drop when speculative fallback hits in large batches (>16) and a surprising spike in prefix-entropy for a tiny subset of prompts. attaching notes below.

josh: can you paste the exact runner command + config so infra can reproduce?

meera: here — ran on a small canary pool (gpu-pool-canary-a):
```
./run_eval --model q4-mini-7b --quant=8bit --speculative=true --fallback_threshold=0.7 --batch_sizes=8,16,32 --kv_cache=on --seed=42 --eval_sets=qa_short,dialog_long
```
results: p95 latency improves ~12% at batch=8 with spec ON, but at batch=32 we see QA F1 -0.8% and EM -0.9 (small but > our alert threshold). perplexity shifts +0.6 on qa_short for the worst 3% of prompts.

nora: interesting — did you check alignment of kv cache and sequence chunk boundaries? sounds like "spectral drift" we've seen when cache windows misalign after quantized matmul round trips.

meera: yup: looked at raw logits traces for a handful. for the affected prompts we see transient token-prob spikes right after a speculative fallback, then the model re-stabilizes. sketch of trace: 
```
prompt_id: 20230419-xx
step: 12 -> sudden prob spike token 'X' (delta +5.2 logits)
followed by dampening over 3 tokens
```

sam: curious what eval metric set you used. is this only QA? any effect on instruct prompts / safety filters?

meera: primary evals: qa_short (SQuAD-ish), dialog_long (conversational continuity), safety_hooks (synthetic triggers). QA showed the measurable drop. dialog_long showed increased repetition events in 0.7% of cases at batch=32. safety_hooks unchanged.

josh: could this be quantization noise interacting with speculative early-exit heuristics? e.g., when speculative path returns earlier logits that are slightly different, fallback merges kv state and causes local perturbation.

nora: that matches the spectral-drift idea. possible mitigation: tighten fallback_threshold or force re-sync of kv-cache on fallback. small perf hit but should fix quality.

meera: i ran a quick patch forcing kv-resync on fallback for batch=32; QA delta dropped to -0.2 and latency penalty ~+4%. i'll schedule a broader pass across more seeds and the other quant profiles (q5, q8) tomorrow.

ops-bot: deploy note: canary patch meera/spec-fallback-resync rolled to gpu-pool-canary-a at 2023-04-19T14:23:10Z :white_check_mark:

sam: good. also might be worth running adversarial prompt set (edge-case lexical blends) — those tend to amplify small logit deltas.

meera: agree. plan: 1) run 3-seed sweep across q4/q5/q8 with resync patch, batch sizes 8/16/32, 2) add adversarial prompts (N=2k) to eval, 3) produce a short summary with per-prompt diffs and a repro script. i'll post results here by EOD tomorrow.

josh: assign me for infra repro if you want me to parallelize the runs.

meera: thanks — will ping when i upload the repro tar.gz. :thumbsup:
